extension.summary: Alle Kodi-Plugins von DevCatSKZ – mit automatischen Updates
All Kodi plugins by DevCatSKZ – with automatic updates
extension.description: Einmal installieren – danach stehen alle DevCatSKZ-Plugins unter „Aus Repository installieren“ und bleiben automatisch aktuell. Enthalten: SKZ Connect (Controller per Bluetooth), Catnewz (Katzen-News), VeraCrypt Manager, Sunshine/Moonlight (Game-Streaming), NewPipe MOD und YouTube.

Install once – all DevCatSKZ plugins then appear under "Install from repository" and stay up to date automatically. Includes: SKZ Connect (controllers via Bluetooth), Catnewz (cat news), VeraCrypt Manager, Sunshine/Moonlight (game streaming), NewPipe MOD and YouTube.
